notes: Paper sets a NEW observed 95% CL limit on the ALP-photon coupling cgamma/Lambda by performing a bump hunt on the published diphoton mass spectrum from one angular bin of PrimEx carbon-target data (Fig. S2, ma ~ 0.10-0.16 GeV; region near the pi0 mass ~0.135 GeV is not excluded, hence the weaker point at 0.125 GeV). Only one explicit numeric anchor exists in the text: at ma = 0.11 GeV, Lambda ~ 0.6 TeV -> cgamma/Lambda ~ 1.7e-3 GeV^-1; best limits near 115 and 160 MeV at ~1e-3 GeV^-1. Other data points are approximate reads from Fig. S2 (right), so treat them as indicative, not digitized. The paper ALSO sets a new observed limit on the ALP-gluon coupling cg/Lambda ~ 1e-4 to 1e-3 GeV^-1 for 0.15 < ma < 0.46 GeV from GlueX public data (Fig. S4), which does not map onto the coupling-type enum and is not extracted here. PrimEx and GlueX sensitivity projections (Fig. 2, Fig. 3) are separate from the observed limits reported here.
